integrity: Finite data exactly checked with standalone standard-library code; the full geometric and nonexistence arguments are proved in RESULT.md. No claim of independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Order-eleven uniqueness and nonexistence of smooth crepant resolution are confined to toric morphisms.
Order-nine obstruction excludes projective crepant resolutions, not arbitrary proper nonprojective resolutions.
Normalized Nash nontermination is sourced from Chen and Zuo and is not reproved.
General toric discrepancy and junior-simplex techniques are prior art; publication priority of the explicit comparison remains subject to independent literature verification.
title: Crepant birational dichotomy for two isolated Nash counterexamples
